subject: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
detail: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed the transcript of the Earnings Call held on Friday, 13th November 2026 at 05:30 P.M.
